scores.evidence: Section 1 explicitly maps NFR-01 through NFR-05 to design impacts and ADRs. E.g., '[NFR-04] ... Zero network requests ... [ADR-004]', '[NFR-01] ... B-tree indexes ... [ADR-003]'.
Section 2 provides full arithmetic: 'Average RPS = (30 * 60) / 86,400', 'Peak RPS = 0.208', 'Storage/year = 10,000 * 25 KB + 40% overhead'. Scale Tier T0 is selected based on these calculations.
Section 3 lists ADR-001 to ADR-004 with 'Alternatives Considered' (e.g., Microservices, PostgreSQL Daemon) and 'Decision' citing NFRs (e.g., '[NFR-04]', '[NFR-01]').

Section 6 maps API-001 to [F-001], API-003 to [F-002], etc. Section 7 maps TBL-03 to [F-001], TBL-05 to [F-002], etc. All features F-001 to F-004 (and implied others in team plan) have corresponding endpoints and tables.
Section 6 uses plural nouns ('/api/v1/specimens', '/api/v1/cold-storage/readings'). Auth rule 'LocalRoleAuth' is specified. Error codes include 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500.

Section 9 covers STRIDE categories: Tampering (T-01, T-03), Information Disclosure (T-02), DoS (T-04), Repudiation (T-05), Elevation of Privilege (T-06). Mitigations are concrete (e.g., 'File permissions restricted to ... 0600', 'Indexed B-tree queries').

Tech choices (React, SQLite) are grounded in ADRs citing NFRs. Capacity numbers (30 users, 10,000 records) are cited from [Q-002] and [NFR-03] context (though 10,000 is an assumption, it is flagged as 'expected operational records' and used consistently). No unprompted tech stack without ADR.
Section 11 defines 'Walking Skeleton (Slice 1)' with specific features [F-001] and APIs. Section 12 provides 'Team plan' with ROLE-01 to ROLE-03, citing F- and ADR- IDs.
